text:
## Common Mistakes (Don't Make These!)  
❌ **Mistake 1:** Accept address change without proof of address for international move
✅ **Correct:** Always verify proof of address for international moves  
❌ **Mistake 2:** Skip AML screening for address to new country
✅ **Correct:** Always screen if customer moves to new country  
❌ **Mistake 3:** Update address without verifying customer identity
✅ **Correct:** Always verify identity before processing change  
❌ **Mistake 4:** Change joint account to one holder's address without consent from both
✅ **Correct:** Obtain written consent from both joint account holders  
❌ **Mistake 5:** Send statement to new address before confirming delivery capability
✅ **Correct:** Verify address is valid before changing statement delivery  
❌ **Mistake 6:** Notify customer of address change before internal systems updated
✅ **Correct:** Complete all system updates first, then notify  
❌ **Mistake 7:** Ignore red flags (multiple changes, fraud indicators)
✅ **Correct:** Escalate any suspicious address changes immediately

raw_entities.name: Change of Address Process
raw_entities.description: A banking operational procedure governing the update of customer address records. The process requires identity verification, proof of address validation, AML screening for international moves, consent from joint account holders where applicable, system updates, and customer notification. The procedure includes mandatory compliance checkpoints and escalation triggers for suspicious activity.
context: Always verify proof of address for international moves
Always screen if customer moves to new country
Always verify identity before processing change
Obtain written consent from both joint account holders

raw_entities.name: Customer Identity Verification
raw_entities.description: Mandatory step to verify customer identity before processing any address change. This step must be completed prior to accepting or updating address information in the system.
context: Always verify identity before processing change
Update address without verifying customer identity

raw_entities.name: Proof of Address Verification
raw_entities.description: Step to validate proof of address documentation provided by the customer. This is particularly critical for international moves and must be completed before address records are updated.
context: Always verify proof of address for international moves
Send statement to new address before confirming delivery capability

raw_entities.name: AML Screening for Address Change
raw_entities.description: Mandatory AML screening step triggered when a customer moves to a new country. This step ensures compliance with anti-money laundering obligations and must be completed before the address change is finalized.
context: Always screen if customer moves to new country
Skip AML screening for address to new country

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Holder Consent Collection
raw_entities.description: Step to obtain written consent from all joint account holders before processing an address change on a joint account. This ensures all parties agree to the address modification.
context: Change joint account to one holder's address without consent from both
Obtain written consent from both joint account holders

raw_entities.name: Address Delivery Capability Verification
raw_entities.description: Step to confirm that the new address is valid and capable of receiving statements and correspondence before updating the address in the system.
context: Verify address is valid before changing statement delivery
Send statement to new address before confirming delivery capability

raw_entities.name: System Address Update
raw_entities.description: Step to update all internal banking systems with the new customer address. This must be completed before any customer notification is sent.
context: Complete all system updates first, then notify
Notify customer of address change before internal systems updated

raw_entities.name: Customer Notification of Address Change
raw_entities.description: Final step to notify the customer that their address has been successfully updated. This notification must only be sent after all internal systems have been updated.
context: Notify customer of address change before internal systems updated
Complete all system updates first, then notify

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Address Change Escalation
raw_entities.description: Step to identify and escalate any suspicious address change patterns, including multiple rapid changes or fraud indicators, to the appropriate compliance or fraud team.
context: Ignore red flags (multiple changes, fraud indicators)
Escalate any suspicious address changes immediately

raw_entities.name: International Move Detection
raw_entities.description: Decision gate that determines whether the address change involves a move to a new country. If yes, triggers mandatory AML screening and enhanced proof of address verification.
context: Always screen if customer moves to new country
Always verify proof of address for international moves

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Detection
raw_entities.description: Decision gate that identifies whether the account is held jointly by multiple customers. If yes, requires written consent from all joint account holders before proceeding.
context: Change joint account to one holder's address without consent from both
Obtain written consent from both joint account holders

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Activity Detection
raw_entities.description: Decision gate that identifies red flags such as multiple rapid address changes or fraud indicators. If detected, triggers immediate escalation to compliance or fraud team.
context: Ignore red flags (multiple changes, fraud indicators)
Escalate any suspicious address changes immediately

raw_entities.name: Identity Verification Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance checkpoint ensuring customer identity is verified before any address change is processed. This gate must be passed to proceed with the address update workflow.
context: Always verify identity before processing change
Update address without verifying customer identity

raw_entities.name: Proof of Address Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance checkpoint requiring valid proof of address documentation, particularly for international moves. Evidence of address verification must be retained.
context: Always verify proof of address for international moves
Accept address change without proof of address for international move

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance checkpoint requiring AML screening when a customer moves to a new country. This gate ensures anti-money laundering obligations are met before finalizing the address change.
context: Always screen if customer moves to new country
Skip AML screening for address to new country

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Consent Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance checkpoint requiring written consent from all joint account holders before processing address changes on joint accounts. Evidence of consent must be documented.
context: Change joint account to one holder's address without consent from both
Obtain written consent from both joint account holders

raw_entities.name: New Customer Address
raw_entities.description: The new address provided by the customer during the address change process. This address must be verified for validity and delivery capability before being recorded in the system.
context: Verify address is valid before changing statement delivery
Send statement to new address before confirming delivery capability

raw_entities.name: Proof of Address Documentation
raw_entities.description: Official documentation provided by the customer to verify their new address. This is mandatory for all address changes and particularly critical for international moves.
context: Always verify proof of address for international moves
Accept address change without proof of address for international move

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Address Change
raw_entities.description: An address change affecting a joint account arrangement. This requires written consent from all joint account holders and must be processed with special care to ensure all parties agree.
context: Change joint account to one holder's address without consent from both
Obtain written consent from both joint account holders

raw_entities.name: International Move AML Screening
raw_entities.description: Mandatory AML screening triggered when a customer's address change involves relocation to a new country. This screening must be completed before the address change is finalized.
context: Always screen if customer moves to new country
Skip AML screening for address to new country

raw_entities.name: Address Change Processor
raw_entities.description: The operational staff member responsible for processing address changes, verifying documentation, updating systems, and ensuring all compliance checkpoints are met.
context: Always verify identity before processing change
Complete all system updates first, then notify

raw_entities.name: Compliance Officer
raw_entities.description: The compliance officer responsible for reviewing suspicious address changes, conducting AML screening for international moves, and escalating red flags.
context: Always screen if customer moves to new country
Escalate any suspicious address changes immediately

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Team
raw_entities.description: The team responsible for investigating and escalating suspicious address change patterns, including multiple rapid changes or fraud indicators.
context: Ignore red flags (multiple changes, fraud indicators)
Escalate any suspicious address changes immediately

raw_entities.description: A natural person who holds a banking account and initiates an address change. The customer must provide identity verification and proof of address documentation.
context: Always verify identity before processing change
Always verify proof of address for international moves

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Holder
raw_entities.description: A customer who holds an account jointly with one or more other customers. All joint account holders must provide written consent before an address change is processed.
context: Change joint account to one holder's address without consent from both
Obtain written consent from both joint account holders
